fixture.legacy.stats.instrumentType: Doubles as a flute when blown across the top
fixture.legacy.stats.description: A quarterstaff Ganji carved himself with his enchanted knife, hollowed through the core and pierced with fingerholes so that blowing across its top turns it into a full-sized flute.
fixture.legacy.stats.bonus: Carved and fitted by his own hand to his exact grip and reach; grants advantage on his first attack roll with it in each fight, and functions as a proper musical instrument.
fixture.legacy.stats.origin: Self-carved using Ganji's enchanted carving knife.
